The main takeaway from our work is that
, during early cleavage, zooxanthella distribution is not random but is determined by a process that is independent of cell division and cell differentiation.
, in contrast to the prevailing notion that zooxanthellalike cells are formed from the mesoglea, the zooxanthella-like cells in the early embryos of these corals originate from the germ line.
, in these two species, zooxanthella distribution is tightly linked to determination of gastrodermal cell fate, and that the distribution pattern of the symbionts in the early embryos is not random.
